On Oct 26, 2022, at 9:41 PM, Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Dear All,
Great to connect today and exciting to see the IIR IPC process restarting.
I'm resharing our response from the last IPC. We provided some insight to the NATO risk framework which was somewhat
limiting and our overall approach to this issue. Do keep in mind that this was prior to us starting the Council. However, as I
mentioned, we're still early in the process. Although, genuine excitement to move the needle on this is there!
Thanks again,
Vera
